:::{#def-convex-optimization-problem}
#### Convex optimization problem, convex problem

A [minimization problem](optimization-constrained.qmd#def-minimization-problem)
whose [objective function](optimization-constrained.qmd#def-objective-function) is [convex](algebra-sums.qmd#def-convex-function)
and whose [feasible set](optimization-constrained.qmd#def-feasible-set) is a [convex set](#def-convex-set)
is a **convex optimization problem** (or **convex problem**)
[@wikipedia_convex_optimization].

:::
